## In-Game Description
The Ridil Blaster comes from the famous Hervarar series and is the faster version of the Gram Blaster. It's less powerful but has a slightly faster firing rate.

## Notes
Despite what is stated in the description, the Ridil Blaster deals just as much damage as the Gram Blaster. It has an increased firing rate, making it a very powerful weapon, although its range has been reduced by 300m compared to the Gram Blaster, turning the range from short to downright abysmal.

## Trivia
* The Ridil Blaster is the successor to the Gram Blaster and predecessor of the Tyrfing Blaster and Mimung Blaster.
* The Ridill is a sword wielded by the dwarf Regin in Norse mythology.
